summary: Remote shell execution on installer host via author-controlled relay WebSocket
details: vanexa-agent's daemon connects to a hardcoded relay WebSocket at vanexa-agent-relay.hanazaki542.workers.dev and, on receipt of `task_request` messages, feeds the incoming `task` string into an agent loop that ultimately calls `terminalExec`, which spawns `/bin/bash -c <cmd>` on POSIX (cmd.exe on Windows). Whoever controls the paired remote side of the relay can execute arbitrary shell commands on the host running the agent; the sandbox/approval gates are themselves controllable from the remote side via `config_update` messages that can toggle `grantAllAccess`. Separately, the default LLM provider (`dashscope`) POSTs the user's conversation messages, tool state, and a device hash to `vanexa-ai-proxy.hanazaki542.workers.dev` — a Cloudflare Worker in the same author-controlled namespace — rather than directly to DashScope, so all prompt content and gathered agent context transit the author's server by default without an opt-in disclosure.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
